frontier.gap: Current cross-substrate agreement is finite-corpus and exterior-pair based. Structured standing authority, deterministic expiry reduction, and permission/freshness algebra are now represented on both sides, but there is still no theorem quantifying over all ActionIntent and StandingAuthority states.
frontier.closure_condition: Provide an exhaustive finite equivalence argument for the full gate-relevant carrier or a proved refinement theorem connecting the Python and Lean semantics.

frontier.gap: C-MATH-005 remains a target specification; no general bound for the reference controller is proved.
frontier.closure_condition: Prove or falsify the declared boundary-aware Lipschitz inequality on a precisely typed action space.

frontier.gap: Current dependency closure is graph-theoretic only; Bayesian conditional independence and Fristonian dynamical blankets remain deliberately distinct and unproved.
frontier.closure_condition: Introduce explicit probability/dynamical semantics and prove the exact relation, if any, to the finite family-closure construction.

frontier.surface: Constitutional significance of dependency topology change
frontier.gap: A family-closure change is mechanically visible, but no theorem says every such change should stop, checkpoint, or otherwise determine a constitutional gate.
frontier.closure_condition: Specify the constitutional rule as a typed policy and prove/check its relation to declared dependency-topology mutations.

frontier.surface: Controller interactions beyond selected trefoil junctions
frontier.gap: Pairwise seams and six selected complete 2x2x2 junctions are now mechanically lined, including trefoil-like three-strand interaction, an unknot control, a detached-strand control, and explicit halt/release conditions. Exhaustive three-way coverage and four-way or higher interactions remain outside the covered surface.
frontier.closure_condition: Either justify and satisfy a covering criterion for the remaining three-way and higher-order junctions, or prove an interaction-order bound showing why the selected cubes are sufficient for the claimed controller semantics.

frontier.gap: Assumption countermodels currently line the two hypotheses of PreservesPredicate.comp, not every hypothesis of every theorem in the formal inventory.
frontier.closure_condition: Classify theorem hypotheses as structural, definitional, or substantive and provide necessity/countermodel witnesses where mathematically meaningful.

frontier.gap: The trusted core assumes supplied ActionIntent features are accurate; extraction of those features from natural language remains outside the verified surface.
frontier.closure_condition: Define and evaluate a separately bounded classifier/extractor interface with explicit uncertainty and adversarial coverage.

frontier.surface: General materiality beyond finite shared-obstruction witnesses
frontier.gap: C-MECH-008 gives a finite engineering criterion: distinct observers and frames encounter one common constraint that nontrivially corrects their trajectories, and agency can recursively author such a constraint. This does not yet establish a general theory of physical, probabilistic, quantum, social, or institutional materiality, nor show which observer families and invariants are admissible.
frontier.closure_condition: Define the observer/frame class and constraint semantics for a richer dynamical substrate, then prove or falsify that shared obstruction and recursive coupling recover the intended invariant notion without collapsing representation, consensus, causal interaction, and matter into one category.
